psychological_meaning: Scorpion, a muted, dusky gray, often evokes feelings of sophistication, mystery, and introspection. It sits comfortably between black and white, suggesting neutrality and balance, while hinting at hidden depths and complexities. It can also represent resilience and adaptability.
